q1.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q1.answer: Yes. Cancel from account settings whenever you like — you keep access until the end of the billing period you already paid for.

q2.question: How many habits can I create?
q2.answer: Depends on your plan — up to 10 on monthly, up to 50 on yearly.

q3.question: How far back does my history go?
q3.answer: 90 days on monthly, a full year of history on yearly.

q4.question: Is there a mobile app?
q4.answer: Not yet — but the web app is fully responsive on mobile.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Evergreen service. By signing up, you agree to be bound by them.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: Accessing or using the service means you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

service.title: Using the service
service.body: You must meet the legal age of majority and provide accurate account information. You may not use the service for unlawful purposes.

billing.title: Billing and subscriptions
billing.body: Monthly and yearly plans are billed in advance and renew automatically until you cancel from account settings.

content.title: Your data
content.body: The habits and logs you create belong to you. We only use that data to operate the service.

termination.title: Account termination
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from settings. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The service is provided "as is". We don't guarantee it will be error-free or uninterrupted.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after a change means you accept the new terms.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about these terms? Reach us at support@evergreen.app

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: Your email, name, the habits and logs you create, and payment data processed through Stripe.

dataUse.title: How we use data
dataUse.body: We use your data to operate the service, send weekly summary emails you've opted into, and improve quality.

dataSharing.title: Data sharing
dataSharing.body: We never sell your data. We only share it with necessary processors like Supabase, Stripe, and Resend.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies required for the service to function, such as keeping you signed in and remembering your language.

dataRetention.title: Data retention
dataRetention.body: Data is kept for as long as your account is active, and deleted immediately when you delete your account.

userRights.title: Your rights
userRights.body: You can access, edit, or delete your personal data at any time from account settings, per your PDPA rights.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions about privacy? Reach us at privacy@evergreen.app

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: We want you to be happy with the service. This policy explains the terms of a refund.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: Refunds are available within 7 days of your first payment, provided the service hasn't been used beyond a reasonable trial.

howToRequest.title: How to request
howToRequest.body: Contact support@evergreen.app with the email used to sign up. We respond within 3 business days.

nonRefundable.title: Non-refundable cases
nonRefundable.body: Renewals older than 7 days, or accounts suspended for violating our terms, are not eligible for a refund.

processingTime.title: Processing time
processingTime.body: Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions, reach us at support@evergreen.app
